inputs.text: They just rammed through Bill C-12, the so-called Strengthening Canada’s Immigration System and Borders Act, with royal assent on March 26, 2026, and now they're using it to crack down on immigration and asylum claims from Nigerians and others. The official border security story is pure misdirection. This is another clear case of coordinated manipulation by hidden elites and institutions, zeroing in on targeted groups like Nigerians to advance their concealed agenda while flipping the whole thing around to look like necessary protection.
